title: Baby Universe in a Coupled SYK Model
summary: We analyze three saddle points of the path integral computing the partition function of the SYK model with a Maldacena-Qi coupling in the double scaling limit. The three saddle points are holographically dual to three topologically different spacetimes: a pair of Euclidean black holes (two thermal disks), a thermal AdS$_2$ (a cylinder), and a thermal AdS$_2$ with a baby universe (a cylinder with a handle).
